negative_scope.rationale: M4-0 D12 RAW_GH_OPERATION_IN_CORE=no; M4-6 allows only typed read/mutate/verify; generic passthrough would collapse adapter boundary

negative_scope.item: Subject revision used as GitHub CAS
negative_scope.rationale: M4-5 D6 SUBJECT_REVISION_IS_EXTERNAL_AUTHORITY_CAS=no; GitHub raw precondition must use authority_source_revision + observed_raw_digest, never subject_expected_revision

negative_scope.item: Normalized digest used as raw CAS
negative_scope.rationale: M4-5 D6 NORMALIZED_PLAN_DIGEST_IS_EXTERNAL_CAS_TOKEN=no; normalized digest is semantic evidence only
